notes.title: New Game from Spice Sacrifice dev - Stardust Demon!!!
notes.content:
Here's our new game!! It's a retro metroidvania. Check it out and wishlist here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2815500/Stardust_Demon/

Similar to Spice Sacrifice, it's also an action-platformer with some funky visual effects. If you like our work, wishlisting really helps us out and enables us to do more. Thank you!!

[h2]Still working on Spice Sacrifice[/h2]

In case you're wondering, we are still developing Spice Sacrifice as well. But seeing as how we'll need to commission artists to complete the full vision for Spice Sacrifice (there's only so much we can do as a small 2 person team), we needed to work on something else first to help our financial situation. We 100% are planning to return to Spice Sacrifice and finish it as soon as we can, thanks for being patient!

notes.title: The game is now re-named "Spice Sacrifice"!
notes.content:
If you've followed Nice Spice already then you should know going forward we're using a new name: Spice Sacrifice. It's still the same game, but with a new name!

Game development is going really well! For the past couple of months, we've been placing enemies, creating attacks, putting in equipment and items, fixing a bunch of bugs, and just a lot of balancing everything in general... we're trying to get the flow of things right so the gameplay and story sections work off of each other well.

Most of what we've been doing isn't super presentable yet, so we haven't been sharing too much... but as things get more polished with the art and stuff, we'll be posting more updates. For now, here's a tease of this dragon spell animation:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40994379/29d339c0eb4cde30b998762b8d49a82504ac5b05.gif[/img]

Thanks for all your support, and make sure to tell your fur-riends about our game!
